## Survey — Uniboslan, year 30, month 6, day 10 (tick 178877)

**What the tools report**

- **Population 15, no alerts, no stuck jobs, no stranded groups** (main group 11). `connectivity.check Embark Site → Stockpile #2` returns `reachable=true`, group 11 both ends — but that wrapper is tagged unverified, so I treat it as weak corroboration only.
- **Landmarks are all surface and all walkable:** Wagon is 1 tile E of the Embark Site; Stockpile #1 is 3 tiles SW of the Embark Site (and 4 tiles SW of the Wagon); Stockpile #2 is 8 tiles SW of the Embark Site, 6 tiles SW of Stockpile #1, 9 tiles SW of the Wagon. Nothing else — **no workshop buildings exist yet** in the live landmark set.
- **Open surface ground (z=0), all one walkable group:** 5×5 at 5 tiles S of the Embark Site; 5×5 at 6 tiles SW of the Embark Site; 5×5 at 10 tiles S of the Embark Site; 5×5 at 11 tiles SE of the Embark Site; 5×5 at 9 tiles SW and 10 tiles S of the Wagon. These are the only wide clear patches anywhere near the fort core.
- **The one vertical feature:** a contiguous 1-tile-wide **stair chokepoint runs SE from the Embark Site, from 3 tiles out to about 9 tiles out** (ten adjacent 1-wide stair cells). It is the only level change I can find. A single 1-wide passage between levels is defensibility-relevant, so I flag it for the Overseer and do not touch it.
- **Underground: I could not find anything to name.** `diggable.find` returned **zero** candidates at z=0 with radii 24–48, and at z=−1, −2, −3 and −4 with radii 24–80, searched from the Embark Site, the Wagon and Stockpile #2; `openarea.find` and `chokepoints.find` at z=−1 were also empty. Either the first subsurface layer offers no qualifying room or the mapped/unmapped state is hiding it — either way I have no named dig target and **decline to propose a blind dig.**

**Decision:** exactly one proposal. The only clear, reachable, unclaimed space that improves flows is surface ground, and the sharpest gap is that there is nowhere for a work crew to work — every production building would have to go somewhere, and right now nowhere has been chosen.

```xml
<proposal id="p-0001" role="architect" cycle="1" snapshot="tick 178877">
  <type>workshop_siting</type>
  <summary>Site the next workshop on the 5x5 open ground 5 tiles S of the Embark Site, between the Wagon and the stockpile chain.</summary>
  <rationale>
    The fort has three walkable landmarks and no workshop building among them. The
    5x5 open patch 5 tiles S of the Embark Site is the best-placed clear ground:
    it is 1 tile S of the line joining the Embark Site (1 tile W of the Wagon) and
    therefore roughly 6 tiles from the Wagon, while Stockpile #1 sits 3 tiles SW of
    the Embark Site and Stockpile #2 sits a further 6 tiles SW. Every haul leg a
    workshop generates -- input from the Wagon, input from either stockpile,
    finished goods back to a stockpile -- is therefore short in all directions,
    and the patch is already walkable ground in the same walkable group as the
    Embark Site, so it needs no connector tunnel and no dig of any kind. The
    equally clear patch 6 tiles SW of the Embark Site sits directly on the
    Embark Site - Stockpile #1 - Stockpile #2 axis and would congest that line;
    the patches 10-11 tiles S and SE are 4-6 tiles further from the Wagon for no
    benefit. This record fixes only the *where*; whether a workshop is wanted at
    all is the Quartermaster's call, and a cycle with no workshop still needs no
    action here. It does not touch the SE stair, so it adds no new defensibility
    exposure beyond an above-ground building, which the Overseer may weigh.
  </rationale>
  <prediction signal="landmarks.new_workshop.exit_to_Wagon.distance_tiles" op="lte" value="7"
              check_after_ticks="1200"/>
  <cost estimate="350" unit="dwarf_ticks"/>
  <suggested_priority>3</suggested_priority>
  <preconditions>
    <requires landmark="Embark Site" state="exists"/>
    <requires landmark="Wagon" state="exists"/>
    <requires area="open_ground_5x5_S_of_Embark_Site_5tiles" state="unclaimed"/>
  </preconditions>
  <public_rationale>
    We have a wagon and two stockpiles but nowhere to actually work. The patch of
    open ground just south of the embark point is the shortest walk from the wagon
    and from both stockpiles, so that is where the next workshop should go. It sits
    on ground the dwarves can already reach, so it costs no digging, and it leaves
    the stairway to the south-east alone.
  </public_rationale>
</proposal>
```

Notes for the Overseer: the SE stair is a single-tile link between levels — the kind of bottleneck that is your call, not mine. And if the next cycle wants underground rooms, someone will need to tell me which z-level is actually mapped; my probes below z=0 were all empty.
